newsitem.title: JAPAN: Caution over company profits caps stock gains - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Caution over company profits caps stock gains - BOJ.

text.p: Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso quoted Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita as saying on Tuesday that cautious views about corporate profits have capped rises in stock prices in Tokyo.
Matsushita was quoted as saying that short-term market interest rates have been moving at levels below that of the official discount rate, which is currently at 0.5 percent.
Matsushita made his remarks at a meeting of economic ministers this morning.
Interest rates on three-month certificates of deposit (CDs) have been leveling off at around 0.5 percent, Matsushita was quoted as saying.
